'''Special ops clone troopers''', also known as '''stealth operations clone troopers''', were a variant of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] intended for use on special missions during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They served similar purposes as [[Special ops clone trooper/Legends|stealth operations clone troopers]].

==History==
Like all clone troopers, special ops troopers were [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and created on the rainy [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. Special ops troopers were first officially seen when they assisted [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] on a prototype [[Stealth ship/Legends|stealth ship]] during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]] against [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]]. The team in the ship were successful in their mission against Trench. They were later used during the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]] under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]]. Due to their specialized equipment, they were able to detect a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian's]] wing vibrations inside a cave before entering, giving them warning of the danger ahead. Ki-Adi-Mundi led his troopers into the cave and were met with a large Geonosian force. Many of the special ops troopers were lost due to the Geonosians' overwhelming numbers and the aerial tactics they were allowed. But the team managed to push forward and left the remaining Geonosians to the [[Flame trooper/Legends|clone flame troopers]]. They were able to reach the rendezvous point at [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] position.

==Equipment==
Large headphones were integrated into special ops troopers' helmets, which gave them enhanced hearing and allowed them to pick up vibrations close by while also giving them extra protection for their ears. Their armor usually had a dark color for camouflage.

==Behind the scenes==
The special ops troopers were originally designed to be communication troopers reminiscent of [[Wikipedia:World War II|World War II]]&ndash;era communications officers. At one point in the design process, they featured antennas protruding from the top of their headphones, a feature which was left in several Hasbro action figures.
